family.description: This 3-layer(aba) sandwich domain is found at the N terminus of S-methyl thiohydantoin desulfurase from Variovorax sp. (S-Me-THD) and similar sequences mainly found in bacteria and fungi. S-Me-THD catalyses the hydrolysis of S-methyl -thiohydantoin-5-propanoate into hydantoin-5-propanoate and methanethiol, the third step in S-methyl ergothioneine degradation [[cite:PUB00155448]].
family.name: S-Me-THD-like, N-terminal domain
